name: codedp-bench-seq-extraction
description: A benchmark that tests models on extracting structured sequences from code and associated artifacts (for example tokens, API-call sequences, or extracted data segments). It measures the ability to identify and output exact target sequences from code snippets or related descriptions, emphasizing precise extraction rather than generation. The dataset is intended to evaluate sequence-level extraction robustness in code-understanding scenarios.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face benchmark with limited adoption, primarily of interest to researchers working on code understanding and information extraction.
